The horizon and step are computed by the accepted iteration factory. successful states integrability and expected squared objective-gradient norm <=epsilon, exactly the source accuracy convention. The additional conditional duration/tie independence is the explicitly user-approved departure, not a condition claimed to be stated in the source. The explicit publicInput reconstructs Family from d,m,n,Lminus,Lpm,Delta,epsilon,x0,S,rho. Its actual compiler body excludes tau, Lplus and lower. Thus this factory knows worker count but cannot use worker latency bounds, the auxiliary mean-square constant or the lower-bound witness. It assumes neither completed-label IID nor the desired moment/time bound. This stronger operational hypothesis is recorded in the approved_departure ledger and was expressly authorized by the user. The concrete private-row freshness and completed-IID derivations remain proof obligations.
